title: proofs
responsibility: Verifies pinned issuer signatures and their exact release, operation and time scope before accepting approval or reviewer sign-off.

inputs.name: verifyProof.proof
inputs.description: Signed approval or sign-off envelope to verify.

inputs.name: verifyProof.expected
inputs.type: { kind: Proof['payload']['kind']; scope: string; after: number }
inputs.description: Reviewed target profile or expected signature scope for this verification.

inputs.name: verifyProof.trusted
inputs.description: Pinned public keys for the eligible approval or reviewer authorities.

inputs.name: verifyProof.now
inputs.description: Time in epoch milliseconds, defaulting to the host clock.

inputs.name: verifyApproval.record
inputs.description: Persisted deployment plan or run being authorized, reconciled, or signed off.

inputs.name: verifyApproval.proof
inputs.description: Signed approval or sign-off envelope to verify.

inputs.name: verifyApproval.registry
inputs.description: Trusted deploy registry, including approved targets, executable paths and signer public keys.

inputs.name: signoffScope.record
inputs.description: Persisted deployment plan or run being authorized, reconciled, or signed off.

inputs.name: verifySignoff.record
inputs.description: Persisted deployment plan or run being authorized, reconciled, or signed off.

inputs.name: verifySignoff.proof
inputs.description: Signed approval or sign-off envelope to verify.

inputs.name: verifySignoff.registry
inputs.description: Trusted deploy registry, including approved targets, executable paths and signer public keys.

outputs.name: verifyProof
outputs.description: No output. Success means the receipt matches the trusted issuer, scope and validity window.

outputs.name: verifyApproval
outputs.description: No output. Success means the correct authority signed this exact mutation attempt.

outputs.name: signoffScope
outputs.description: The digest binding a completed deployment plan, provider receipt and route smoke evidence.

outputs.name: verifySignoff
outputs.description: No output. Success means an authorized reviewer signed the exact verified deployment.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The operation could not verify its input, target identity, or expected result.
